title: Pokémon TCG- S&V Paradox Rift- Porygon-Z 144/182 Holo Rare (NM/M)
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Porygon-Z card is a must-have for any serious collector of Pokémon Trading Card Game cards. With a powerful 150 HP, this Stage 2 card is a force to be reckoned with in battles. The card features a stunning holo finish and is made from high-quality card stock material.

The card is part of the Scarlet & Violet - Paradox Rift set and has the card number 144/182. It is a Standard size card and was manufactured by Nintendo in the United States in 2023. The card is in English language and is perfect for players aged 6 and above. Don't miss out on the chance to add this amazing card to your collection!
